senses.gloss: kṣudra, cf. Prakrit cūla=culla ‘small’; prefixed to the names of persons, localities, etc., in order to distinguish them from [] others; e. g., Kṣudra-Mūla, Mahā-Mūla; Kṣudra-Dharmagiri, Mahā-Dharmagiri.

Kṣudraka (CII 1), a person of a low position; a poor man.
 (JNSI, Vol. XVI, p. 44), same as tolaka or draṃkṣaṇa; also spelt kṣudrama.
kṣudraka , same as draṃkṣaṇa or tola (q. v.); cf. kṣudrama.
kṣudrama, see kṣudraka; same as tolaka.
kṣudrama , variant of kṣudraka; same as tola (q. v.).

kṣūṇa (EI 3), fault or defect.
 Cf. kṣūṇāni (LP), probably, ‘expenses’; kṣūṇ-ādika, ‘expenses, etc.’
 Cf. mānak-aikaṃ yāvat kṣūṇaṃ na hi (LP), ‘it matters not if there is a loss of one maund only’, i. e. such a case should not be considered a loss.
